verdict.rationale: Loops documents a POST /transactional endpoint for sending one-to-one transactional email with data variables and attachments. Its docs explicitly position receipts, password resets and login codes as sent alongside marketing email from one API and one contact model, and the endpoint is also reachable via SDKs, the CLI and MCP. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of transactional sending (the community evidence does not address it), and magic links and notifications are not named explicitly beyond login codes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
